title: Realtime 3D diffusion in Minecraft ⛏️
author: najsonepls
selftext:
One of the coolest projects I've ever worked on, this was built using SAM-3D on fal serverless. We stream the intermediary diffusion steps from SAM-3D, which includes geometry and then color diffusion, all visualized in Minecraft!

Try it out! [https://github.com/blendi-remade/falcraft](https://github.com/blendi-remade/falcraft)

replies.author: TruelyDashing
replies.body: I’m not OP so I don’t have the answer for this specific application, but there’s nothing special about the cloud services, they just have more horsepower and will get it done faster. You can have a locally hosted LLM run this stuff, just gotta have the beef to generate quickly or the patience to wait (and the hope the app doesn’t time out and crash)
